title: Writing / Voice / Worldly
slide_intent: Write with cultural awareness so a global audience can understand references and feel addressed.
strategic_value: Examples spanning news, entertainment and multilingual replies can help Duolingo express curiosity without defaulting to insider slang.
demonstration: The page compares Interested, Knowledgeable, Universal and Multilingual examples with narrow or less suitable alternatives.
practical_value: Check whether a reference travels across audiences and whether a reply respects the recipient’s language.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Worldly heading, localization rationale and positive/negative lists at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack four comparison rows at right, preserving the Spanish-response example and the distinction between informed references and obscure slang.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source explicitly links worldwide reach with content that excludes no one.
reference_purposes.Expression: Examples use informed cultural references and multilingual replies.
reference_purposes.Application: Four comparisons help writers assess breadth, comprehensibility and language choice.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source rejects references likely to be misunderstood and distinguishes multilingual writing from English-only replies.

ingredient.name: Worldly voice
ingredient.application: Use understandable references and appropriate multilingual replies; preserve meaning during localization.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior. The displayed trait says multilingual but English first; it does not require English-only replies.
